Our Achievements & Historical Milestones

For 45 years, AOPSTSMA has stood as the unyielding legal and institutional shield for private secondary training schools across Odisha.

🏛️1980
FOUNDING CHARTER

State-wide Coalition Established

Formed as the registered apex association under Societies Registration Act XXI of 1860, uniting non-government teacher training institutions across Odisha under one voice.

⚖️2008
ORISSA HIGH COURT

Writ Petition 10372 of 2008 & Interim Stay

Successfully challenged arbitrary state derecognition orders in the High Court of Orissa, obtaining a landmark stay protecting the operations of 56+ training schools.

🛡️2010
SUPREME COURT OF INDIA

National Recognition & Autonomy Upheld

Carried the cause to the Supreme Court of India, securing decisive judicial protection for private secondary training colleges and teacher educators.

🎓2020s
INSTITUTIONAL CONTINUITY

45,000+ Certified Teacher Graduates Protected

Continuous coordination with the Board of Secondary Education (BSE) and NCTE, ensuring uninterrupted conduct of examinations and degree validation.

What the Association Does

A single training school rarely has the resources to fight an adverse departmental order or regulatory shift on its own. Standing together, member institutions have a unified legal shield and institutional voice.

Legal Defense & Representation

The association files, coordinates, and funds landmark litigations in the High Court of Orissa and the Supreme Court of India, ensuring member schools receive immediate stay orders and certified judicial relief.

DIR Recognition & Board Renewals

Authoritative guidance on DIR recognition timelines, NCTE compliance parameters, and regulatory submissions required by the Board of Secondary Education (BSE) Odisha.

Policy Advocacy with Government

Formal representations to the Department of School and Mass Education (S&ME) and higher authorities, protecting the rights and financial viability of private training schools.
